description: Build the outstanding PUBLIC, votable feedback board inside the particle sim (no PII exposed), fix the email-optional submit bug, and add a new Settings page/screen with an 'auto-fill my email on feedback' preference (DEFAULT OFF) that pre-fills the feedback email only when ON AND logged in. All data is real Postgres rows (PGLite locally / Neon in prod) — no mock/seed data; empty states reflect genuinely empty queries. Nothing here may force login. Depends on FEAT-002 (auth) for the logged-in email + server-side preference persistence.
steps: EMAIL-OPTIONAL FIX (real bug): in src/lib/feedback/types.ts the submitFeedbackSchema.userEmail is `z.string().trim().email().optional()` — an empty string fails .email() with 'Invalid input' even though the field is labeled optional. Make blank/undefined pass while a provided value is still validated as an email. Use a schema that treats '' as undefined, e.g. `z.preprocess((v) => (typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() === '' ? undefined : v), z.string().trim().email().optional())`. In src/components/lab/feedback-dialog.tsx ensure the client resolver + payload construction let a blank email submit successfully (it already strips empty to undefined in the payload, but the zodResolver rejects before submit — the schema fix must make the resolver accept blank). Add/adjust a test asserting blank email parses OK and an invalid non-empty email still rejects.

PUBLIC BOARD DATA LAYER (no PII): in src/lib/feedback/server.ts add `listPublicFeedback()` that SELECTs only public columns — id, type, title, category, description, status, votes, created_at — and NEVER selects user_email or any PII. Add `incrementFeedbackVotes(id)` that does `update feedback set votes = votes + 1 where id = $1 returning <public columns>` and returns the updated public row (or null if missing). Add a client-safe PublicFeedbackItem type in types.ts (the FeedbackItem shape minus user_email and the admin-only fields you choose to withhold — at minimum omit user_email). Keep types.ts free of server imports.

PUBLIC BOARD SERVER FUNCTIONS: in src/lib/feedback/functions.ts add `listPublicFeedbackFn` (createServerFn GET or POST) that dynamically imports ./server.ts and returns listPublicFeedback() with NO auth required and NO email in the payload; and `voteFeedbackFn` (POST) validated by a new zod schema { id: string } that dynamically imports ./server.ts and calls incrementFeedbackVotes. Add a lightweight throttle to voteFeedbackFn using ./throttle.server.ts (a new allow-key like `vote:<ip>`), consistent with submitFeedbackFn. Do NOT require login to vote. Do NOT expose user_email anywhere in these payloads.

PUBLIC BOARD UI INSIDE THE SIM: create src/components/lab/feedback-board.tsx — a Radix Dialog (mirror feedback-dialog.tsx structure/styling) OR an in-sim panel that lists public feedback fetched via listPublicFeedbackFn. Show type, title, category, description, status, votes, created_at (coerce created_at like admin.feedback.tsx formatCreatedAt). Provide an Upvote button per item that calls voteFeedbackFn and optimistically increments the count. BEST-EFFORT ONE-VOTE-PER-ITEM WITHOUT LOGIN: track voted ids in localStorage (e.g. key 'helion.voted-feedback' -> array of ids); disable/hide the upvote control for already-voted ids and skip the server call; this is abuse-resistant enough for a small app (document it is best-effort, not a hard guarantee). Order by votes desc (top-voted first); optionally group or badge by status (under_review/planned/in_progress/completed/declined). Empty state must reflect a genuinely empty query (no fabricated rows).

WIRE BOARD INTO THE SIM: add `boardOpen`/`setBoardOpen` to src/store/lab-store.ts (mirroring feedbackOpen). Mount <FeedbackBoard /> in src/components/lab/lab-app.tsx next to <FeedbackDialog />. Add a 'Board' (or 'Roadmap'/'Ideas') button in src/components/lab/hud.tsx next to the existing Feedback button that calls setBoardOpen(true). This is the public board entry point INSIDE the sim (not a separate admin route).

SETTINGS PREFERENCE MODEL: create a preferences module. Client-safe defaults live in a shared file (e.g. src/lib/settings/types.ts): `type UserPreferences = { autofillFeedbackEmail: boolean }` with DEFAULT = { autofillFeedbackEmail: false }. Make the structure easy to extend (a single object of named prefs). Persistence: (a) LOGGED-OUT: persist in localStorage (key e.g. 'helion.preferences'). (b) LOGGED-IN: persist SERVER-SIDE keyed to the account so it survives across sessions. Add a migration migrations/0003_preferences.sql creating a table e.g. `user_preferences (user_id text primary key, autofill_feedback_email boolean not null default false, updated_at timestamptz not null default now())` (follow 0002_feedback.sql style/numbering). Add src/lib/settings/server.ts with getPreferences(userId)/upsertPreferences(userId, prefs) via getSql() (server-only), and src/lib/settings/functions.ts with getPreferencesFn/updatePreferencesFn that use authMiddleware (per-user) so they run only for logged-in users; logged-out clients use localStorage only and never call these (or the fns must fail gracefully). Keep types.ts import-free of server code.

SETTINGS ROUTE + ENTRY POINT: create src/routes/settings.tsx (file-based route; routeTree.gen.ts regenerates on build/dev) rendering a Settings screen with a section for preferences. Include the 'Auto-fill my email on feedback' toggle using the Radix switch primitive (@radix-ui/react-switch is a dependency; check src/components/ui for an existing Switch wrapper and use it, else use the primitive). Behavior: DEFAULT OFF. When logged in, load the preference from getPreferencesFn and save changes via updatePreferencesFn (persist server-side). When logged out, load/save via localStorage. Show context: when logged out, explain the preference is stored locally and email auto-fill needs an account. Make the settings layout easy to extend with more preferences later (map over a preferences section). Add a Settings entry point from the sim UI (a gear button in hud.tsx that navigates to /settings, and/or a link in the account control). Do NOT gate /settings behind login — logged-out users can open it and toggle the local preference.

FEEDBACK FORM AUTO-FILL WIRING: in src/components/lab/feedback-dialog.tsx, read the effective preference + current user. When (preference.autofillFeedbackEmail === true) AND user is logged in AND has an email, pre-fill the email field with the account email on open (via react-hook-form defaultValues/reset). When the preference is OFF, or the user is logged out, the email field stays blank (and remains optional per the fix). The auto-filled email is still stored to the private user_email column only — it must NEVER be shown on the public board. Resolve the logged-in preference via getPreferencesFn (guard on isPending / logged-in) and the logged-out preference via localStorage; default OFF if unknown.

TESTS: extend src/lib/feedback/feedback.test.ts (real PGLite via the existing loader hook): (a) blank/undefined userEmail parses OK and a bad non-empty email rejects; (b) listPublicFeedback returns rows WITHOUT a user_email field even when the underlying row has an email set (assert the projection omits it); (c) incrementFeedbackVotes increments votes and persists (insert real row, vote, re-read). Add a settings test (new file, wired into package.json `test` list, using the loader hook so migrations incl. 0003 apply): upsertPreferences then getPreferences returns the stored value; getPreferences for an unknown user returns the default (autofillFeedbackEmail:false). No seeded/mock rows anywhere — all via real inserts.
acceptance_criteria: Submitting feedback with a BLANK email succeeds end to end (schema + client resolver accept it); a provided invalid email still rejects.

listPublicFeedbackFn returns real rows with type/title/category/description/status/votes/created_at and NO user_email (verified in a test asserting the field is absent even when the row has an email).

The public board is reachable from inside the sim (a HUD button opens it) and shows real submitted items; upvoting increments the count, persists to Postgres, and localStorage prevents a trivial repeat vote on the same item.
A /settings route exists, is reachable from the sim UI, and is NOT gated behind login.

The 'auto-fill my email on feedback' toggle DEFAULTS OFF; when ON and logged in the feedback email field pre-fills with the account email; when OFF or logged out it stays blank. A logged-in user's preference persists across sessions (server-side, user_preferences table); logged-out uses localStorage.
The auto-filled/private email is never shown on the public board or any public server-function payload.
migrations/0003_preferences.sql applies cleanly on PGLite (dev) and via scripts/migrate.mjs; migration-plan.test.mjs still passes.
New/extended tests pass and are wired into `npm test`; no NEW typecheck errors beyond the pre-existing FEAT-001 set; `npm run build` exits 0.
verification: npm run dev then manually: submit feedback logged-out with blank email (succeeds); open board from HUD, confirm no email shown, upvote increments + persists on reload; open /settings, confirm toggle defaults OFF, turn ON while logged in and confirm feedback email pre-fills; logged out confirm it stays blank
